$comment: Vendored slice (node only) of the examples repo snippet manifest (AAASM-4512 / Epic AAASM-4511). Copied into this repo — NOT fetched at build time — so the quick-start framework tabs build offline and are drift-gated locally. Each `snippet_path` is relative to this file; each `.ts` under node/ is a verbatim copy of the `region: quickstart` slice of the referenced runnable example. `status` (validated | experimental) is curated display metadata that drives tab label + order: validated frameworks render first with a plain label, experimental frameworks render after with an `(Experimental)` label suffix. To refresh: re-copy the snippets from the examples repo and re-run `pnpm run generate:docs-metadata`.
